meta.note: Pure dormant API contract. No DOM. No network. No production import.

startEstimator.description: Create new estimator session from entry context. Apply priority chain for métier/service resolution.

answerEstimatorQuestion.signature: answerEstimatorQuestion(session: EstimatorSession, question_id: string, answer: any): EstimatorSession
answerEstimatorQuestion.description: Record client answer. Validate input type. Update known_inputs. Re-run question planner.
answerEstimatorQuestion.validation: Answer must match canonical input data_type and allowed_values

getNextEstimatorStep.description: Determine current state and next required action: question to ask, or readiness for engine.
getNextEstimatorStep.returns: { state, next_question: QuestionPlannerOutput | null, ready_for_engine: boolean }

evaluateEstimator.description: Build engine payload, call evaluateFixeoPrice(), translate result to ClientOutcome. Sole price calculation entry point.
evaluateEstimator.returns: EstimatorSession with engine_result and outcome populated
evaluateEstimator.calls: evaluateFixeoPrice() from pricing-engine-core-v1.js — the ONLY price source

buildPricingContextToken.description: Create immutable handoff token for Reservation. Only callable when session has valid outcome.
buildPricingContextToken.returns: PricingContextToken (documentation only — no crypto in V1)

accessibility_contract.focus_management: Focus moves to next question after answer. Focus returns to CTA on close.
accessibility_contract.screen_reader_labels: All inputs have aria-label or aria-labelledby
accessibility_contract.modal_escape: ESC closes modal. Focus returns to trigger.
accessibility_contract.mobile_keyboard: Numeric keyboard for number inputs. Form input does not jump behind keyboard.
accessibility_contract.no_color_only_status: Status communicated with text + icon, not color alone.

mobile_contract.layout: Mobile-first. Single column. Large touch targets (min 44px).
mobile_contract.bottom_sheet: Modal renders as bottom sheet on mobile
mobile_contract.keyboard_open: Input stays visible above keyboard. Scroll to input on focus.
mobile_contract.back_navigation: Back button returns to previous question / state
mobile_contract.scroll_restoration: Return to top of question on step change
mobile_contract.close_control: X button always accessible at top-right. Not hidden by keyboard.
mobile_contract.result_summary: Price result sticky at bottom on mobile for easy access to CTA
